title: Distance sensor
description: Measures the distance to the nearest object in one direction (time-of-flight, ultrasonic or infrared).

distance.description: Distance to the nearest object, or null when nothing is in range.

valid.description: False when nothing is in range or the reading is unreliable.

set_range.description: Ignore objects further away than this.

angle.description: Direction relative to the bot's front, + = left.
